_note: No `include` and no `files` anywhere in the tsconfig chain: the compiler defaults `include` to `**/*`, so the component and `src/t.ts`, which no component imports, are both checked, and `exclude` still keeps `dist` out. The overlay tsconfig always sets `files` (the shim declarations), which would turn that default into an empty `include`, so the overlay writes `**/*` out. svelte-check --tsgo does the same since 4.7.7; before it, it checked nothing here.
